title: Advanced Ratio Analysis for Stock Selection
description: A practical, ratio-by-ratio framework for selecting stocks, built for investors who already know how to read a P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statement and want to go further. Goes beyond textbook definitions into comparability, sector-relative benchmarking, and the traps that make a ratio look good on paper while the underlying business deteriorates. Uses real NSE and BSE listed companies, Screener.in data, and full worked case studies throughout, and closes with a chapter on applying the same framework to evaluate mutual fund holdings.
